integrity.classification_basis: Two exact adjacent-parameter ratios prove strict coordinate growth for the degree-to-Euler quotient on n,d at least two.
integrity.degree_basis: Arrondo--Bernardi explicitly state that the multiplication map from the d-fold product of projective space to the split variety is finite of degree d!.
integrity.euler_basis: The split variety is topologically the symmetric product, and the Macdonald identity gives the symmetric-power Euler generating function.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv and institutional records for 0903.2757 date the first public preprint to 2009-03-16.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Same-object Chow-rank literature is classified under MSC 14N05, Projective techniques in algebraic geometry; the underlying split-form paper is math.AG.

scientific_limitations: Only the natural projective degree and ordinary topological Euler characteristic are compared.
The finite bijection from the symmetric product is used only to identify the underlying complex topological space; no scheme-isomorphism claim is made.
The comparison is elementary after classical formulas are combined, so an older or unindexed source may contain the same factorial-versus-binomial classification.
title: A unique degree–Euler equality for Chow varieties of split forms
